_doc: Registry of GitHub repos connected to Vercel projects. Source-of-truth for the deploy notifier (E2.2). Validated by scripts/validate_deploy_targets.py. Reconciled against Vercel API by scripts/sync_deploy_targets.py (every 12h). Per-entry shape: name (kebab-case, unique), github_repo ('owner/repo'), vercel_project_id (^prj_[A-Za-z0-9]+$), vercel_org_id (^team_[A-Za-z0-9]+$ OR null for personal account), framework (in known_frameworks), env_var_keys (list of .env.larry KEYs to surface as Vercel project env vars; declared, not validated at parse time), branch_filter (null = all branches OR glob string like 'forge/*'), preview_enabled (bool, default true), production_enabled (bool, default false — Phase E2 is preview-only), created_at (YYYY-MM-DD), notes (may be empty). Initial state is intentionally empty; first real entry (ourliberty-dashboard) lands in E2.3 once real Vercel IDs exist.

deploy_targets.name: ourliberty-dashboard
deploy_targets.notes: First E2.3 deploy target. Hobby tier Vercel account (larry-yatch personal). Scaffolded with Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + App Router on 2026-05-20. Will host the read-only dashboard B in E3.

deploy_targets.name: rsdpm
deploy_targets.notes: RSDPM - Larry's first external product (operator-portfolio weight 0.7, active-build). Team-scoped Vercel project (vercel_org_id team_8ED9iFho5H5MTxImDHD6eGBE), unlike the personal-account ourliberty-dashboard. GitHub Larry-Yatch/RSDPM, production branch main. Runtime env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, ZOOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN) are managed directly on the Vercel project and are absent from .env.larry, so env_var_keys is intentionally empty. Registered to clear recurring MISSING_FROM_REGISTRY drift (G-rule sync-deploy-targets-missing-registry-001).
